question: On genuinely fresh real-source evaluation resets, does PPO training destroy initially useful history-motion control, and does a prospectively fixed KL-to-initial-policy penalty prevent damage while improving reward-only acquisition? Distinguish actor damage from critic-only updates.
hypotheses: If the historical favorable initialization seed4507 has fresh-seed source original return >=150, original P20 PPO training may lose >25 return on this fresh heldout source.

Adding a fixed β=1 penalty to KL(initial_policy || current_actor) on actual on-policy PPO minibatch states will preserve fresh-source initial competence better than standard PPO, with identical initial weights/training source seeds and budget.

A separate critic-only arm, with recurrent trunk/actor frozen, preserves exactly its initial greedy action map while updating value head; this is a nonlearning-policy reference, not an improved learner.

training.seed4507_selected_a_priori_from_P30_as_f: known development-seed positive control; never treat as independent discovery
training.KL_formula: KL(categorical initial actor || categorical current actor) mean over the SAME on-policy factual source states as PPO update. Detached frozen reference logits. Coefficient exactly 1.0; no gradient to reference. Add to standard P20 actor+critic+entropy clipped loss.
training.critic_only: Freeze ALL recurrent and actor parameters; AdamW update critic head only using same real source returns/value loss, same 576 minibatch update counts, no actor loss gradients, no KL. Distinguish effective parameter counts and updates.
training.normalization: same original P30 deterministic past-only motion features and source P19 six raw scale, no fitted normalization

frozen_metrics.reward_metric: real original source environment return out of 200, mean over 8 independent heldout resets per seed and condition
frozen_metrics.all_three_seeds_primary_optimization_sup: KL anchored must exceed standard by >=25 on original and average of both unseen source physics variants, each seed; anchored must reach >=150 original for all 3 seeds and >=100 on each heldout variant per seed; actor drift lower than standard.
frozen_metrics.historical_favorable_seed4507_retest_adm: If initial_no_update fresh original-source score >=150, damage criterion compares same heldout source to standard PPO and accepts >=25 point decline as reproducible exploratory damage. Otherwise 'cannot adjudicate known initial competence' instead of claiming damage.
frozen_metrics.seed4507_retention_success: If admitted, anchored final original return >=initial_no_update_return -20 and >=standard_motion_ppo_return+25; impossible to claim acquisition if anchored merely retains initial skill, record separately.
frozen_metrics.critic_policy_identity: must have EXACT initial vs critic-only greedy action matches for all post-train fixed source probe histories, zero KL, equal true returns on each heldout original source episode; fail engineering if violated.
frozen_metrics.actor_KL_probe: mean KL(initial||trained) over original fresh source publicly executed pre-registered probe histories, no hidden source labels
frozen_metrics.worst_case_negative_control: Fully qualified original finite-difference 2-frame conventional rule-based 200/200 prior benchmark; must run and report, never call fully trained neural baseline.
frozen_metrics.source_reward_only_acquisition_no_regres: If anchored fails frozen 150 target or long/short transfer, report science fail even if improved over standard. Superiority over conventional requires equal or better scores in ALL 3 seeds and conditions.
frozen_metrics.scientific_reproducibility: 3 frozen seeds including one historically selected positive control; do not call independent 3-seed scientific PASS if only the previously identified seed meets retention.
